findings.description: Priority 1 recommendation bullets lack specific data anchors; generic "Raise contrast ratio" and "Fix design tokens" are copy‑pasteable.
Priority 2 recommendation bullets generic "Order headings without skipping levels"; no selector or page reference.
Priority 3 recommendation bullets generic "Wrap primary content in <main>"; no specific element or page.
Priority 4 recommendation bullets generic "Replace landmark containers with semantic elements"; no selector or page reference.
Use of US spelling "color" instead of UK "colour", indicating English drift.
